strings.zh: 哇！真的是冠军本人哎！
strings.en: Whoa! It really is the Champion!

strings.zh: 您好啊{VAR:0103:0}先生,{NEWLINE}我是在这一带锻炼的训练家。{SCROLL}我刚刚遇到个充满活力的少年,{NEWLINE}跟我说联盟冠军来到了若叶镇。{CLEAR}我还想着他是不是在胡说,{CLEAR}结果就看到您走了过来。{SCROLL}不过现实中看本人{NEWLINE}跟电视里还真不一样啊。{CLEAR}如果不是我这样的铁杆粉丝,{CLEAR}恐怕很难一眼认出您吧。
strings.en: Hello, Mr. {VAR:0103:0}. I’m a Trainer who{NEWLINE}trains around here.{SCROLL}I just met a really energetic boy who{NEWLINE}said the League Champion had come to{CLEAR}New Bark Town.{SCROLL}I figured he was making it up, and then{NEWLINE}I saw you walking this way!{SCROLL}But you do look different in person than{NEWLINE}on TV.{SCROLL}Only a die-hard fan like me could{NEWLINE}recognize you at a glance!
strings.notes: Route 29 fan: male (#1, Mr.) / female (#2, Ms.) player.

strings.zh: 您好啊{VAR:0103:0}小姐,{NEWLINE}我是在这一带锻炼的训练家。{SCROLL}我刚刚遇到个充满活力的少年,{NEWLINE}跟我说联盟冠军来到了若叶镇。{CLEAR}我还想着他是不是在胡说,{CLEAR}结果就看到您走了过来。{SCROLL}不过现实中看本人{NEWLINE}跟电视里还真不一样啊。{CLEAR}如果不是我这样的铁杆粉丝,{CLEAR}恐怕很难一眼认出您吧。
strings.en: Hello, Ms. {VAR:0103:0}. I’m a Trainer who{NEWLINE}trains around here.{SCROLL}I just met a really energetic boy who{NEWLINE}said the League Champion had come to{CLEAR}New Bark Town.{SCROLL}I figured he was making it up, and then{NEWLINE}I saw you walking this way!{SCROLL}But you do look different in person than{NEWLINE}on TV.{SCROLL}Only a die-hard fan like me could{NEWLINE}recognize you at a glance!

strings.zh: 自从看了您的比赛之后,{NEWLINE}我就被您的战斗风格深深吸引。{CLEAR}一直以来都以您为目标努力修行。{CLEAR}今天能见到您真是万分荣幸,{CLEAR}您能与我来一场对战,{CLEAR}让我见识一下冠军的实力吗？
strings.en: Ever since I watched your matches,{NEWLINE}I’ve been hooked on your battle style.{SCROLL}I’ve always trained with you as my goal.{NEWLINE}Meeting you today is a huge honor!{SCROLL}Would you battle me and show me what a{NEWLINE}Champion can do?

strings.zh: 不愧是冠军！{NEWLINE}我觉得自己已经锻炼到极限了,{CLEAR}却还是被您给轻易打败。
strings.en: That’s the Champion for you!{SCROLL}I thought I’d trained myself to the{NEWLINE}limit, but you beat me so easily.

strings.zh: 冠军大人是准备在城都地区旅行吧。{SCROLL}在我们城都地区{NEWLINE}有各种层次的训练家,{CLEAR}相对较弱的训练家看到您这样的强者,{CLEAR}恐怕会避而不战。{CLEAR}实力中等的训练家,{CLEAR}平均水平大致在65级左右,{CLEAR}他们可能会主动向您发起挑战。{CLEAR}而实力较强的训练家{CLEAR}平均水平大致在80级左右,{CLEAR}虽然也会在郊外锻炼,{CLEAR}但不会主动向路人挑战。{CLEAR}您如果想跟他们较量{CLEAR}需要主动过去与他们搭话。{SCROLL}您可以通过与普通训练家对战,{NEWLINE}锻炼在城都地区刚捉到的精灵。{CLEAR}也可以去找强力训练家对战,{CLEAR}磨合您已经成型的强力队伍。
strings.en: You’re about to travel around Johto,{NEWLINE}aren’t you, Champion?{SCROLL}Here in Johto, there are Trainers of{NEWLINE}every level.{SCROLL}The weaker ones will probably avoid{NEWLINE}battling someone as strong as you.{SCROLL}Mid-level Trainers average around{NEWLINE}Lv. 65, and they may challenge you on{CLEAR}their own.{SCROLL}Strong Trainers average around Lv. 80.{SCROLL}They train out in the wild too, but they{NEWLINE}won’t challenge passersby.{SCROLL}If you want to take them on, you’ll{NEWLINE}have to talk to them yourself.{SCROLL}Battling ordinary Trainers is a good way{NEWLINE}to train the Pokémon you’ve just{CLEAR}caught in Johto.{SCROLL}Or you can battle strong Trainers to{NEWLINE}fine-tune your powerhouse team.

strings.zh: 谢谢您愿意驻足与我切磋,{NEWLINE}我会继续在这一带锻炼,{CLEAR}您如果需要锻炼的对手,{CLEAR}我随时可以陪您。
strings.en: Thanks for stopping to battle with me.{NEWLINE}I’ll keep training around here.{SCROLL}If you ever need a sparring partner,{NEWLINE}I’m ready anytime.

strings.zh: 你好啊冠军大人,{NEWLINE}现在要与我对战的吗？
strings.en: Hello, Champion. Want to battle me now?

strings.zh: 随时欢迎您来找我。
strings.en: Come find me anytime.

strings.zh: 你知道口袋竞技吗？
strings.en: Do you know about the Pokéathlon?
strings.notes: Pokéathlon girl Nana (#9–#14, #26–#30, #47): #12 (admire) → #45/#46 friendly battle; #13 (sneer) → #14 battle, then #26–#30 follow-up. 电击兽 athlete, ‘striped yellow Pokémon’ = Electabuzz line.

strings.zh: 口袋竞技不同于口袋妖怪对战,{NEWLINE}是训练家指挥精灵进行的体育类竞技。
strings.en: The Pokéathlon isn’t like a Pokémon{NEWLINE}battle.{SCROLL}It’s a sport where Trainers guide their{NEWLINE}Pokémon through athletic events.

strings.zh: 我小时候看口袋竞技转播时,{NEWLINE}看到过一位使用电击兽的运动员,{CLEAR}虽然他每次比赛都是最后一名,{CLEAR}可他从来没有放弃过。{CLEAR}那坚毅的眼神让我感动至今。{CLEAR}你也特别崇拜这样的人吧？
strings.en: When I was little, I saw a Pokéathlon{NEWLINE}athlete on TV who used Electabuzz.{SCROLL}He came in last every time, but he never{NEWLINE}gave up.{SCROLL}The grit in his eyes still moves me. You{NEWLINE}look up to people like that too, right?

strings.zh: 对啊,永不言弃真的让人敬佩！
strings.en: Yes! Never giving up is admirable!

strings.zh: 实力不行的人趁早放弃吧。
strings.en: Losers should just give up early.

strings.zh: 你在瞧不起谁啊！只要不放弃,{NEWLINE}总是会有改变和进步的吧！{CLEAR}如果你不相信努力的力量,{CLEAR}那我就用精灵对战让你见识一下！
strings.en: Who are you looking down on?!{SCROLL}As long as you don’t give up, you’ll{NEWLINE}always change and improve!{SCROLL}If you don’t believe in hard work, I’ll{NEWLINE}show you in a Pokémon battle!

strings.zh: 这里是２９号道路{NEWLINE}西　吉野市
strings.en: Rt. 29{NEWLINE}West to Cherrygrove City

strings.zh: 这里是２９号道路{NEWLINE}东　若叶镇
strings.en: Rt. 29{NEWLINE}East to New Bark Town

strings.zh: 您希望单打还是双打？
strings.en: Would you like a Single Battle or a{NEWLINE}Double Battle?

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 没问题,来吧！
strings.en: No problem. Here I come!

strings.zh: 不愧是冠军,真强啊。
strings.en: That’s the Champion for you. So strong.

strings.zh: 猫头夜鹰『Noc——tow！
strings.en: Noctowl: Noc-tow!

strings.zh: 电击怪『Elee——ki！
strings.en: Elekid: Elee-ki!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『居然潜入实验室偷东西,{NEWLINE}会不会是火箭队干的？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sneaking into a lab to steal...{NEWLINE}Could Team Rocket be behind this?

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……呜呜……{NEWLINE}我本来对自己努力的成果很有信心,{CLEAR}结果今天很惨地输给了一个{CLEAR}瞧不起别人努力的家伙,呜……
strings.en: Waaah... *sob*... I was so sure of my{NEWLINE}hard work...{SCROLL}But today I lost miserably to a jerk who{NEWLINE}looks down on effort. *sniff*...

strings.zh: 不行,我奈奈决不能气馁。{NEWLINE}我崇拜的那位口袋竞技运动员,{CLEAR}他每次都是最后一名,{CLEAR}却永远都乐观昂扬地奋斗着。{CLEAR}不断追求这种精神的我,{CLEAR}也要有绝不认输的毅力！
strings.en: No, I, Casey, must not lose heart!{SCROLL}The Pokéathlon athlete I look up to{NEWLINE}came in last every time, yet he always{CLEAR}kept fighting with a smile.{SCROLL}I’m chasing that spirit, so I need the{NEWLINE}will to never give up, too!
strings.notes: 奈奈 → Nana (invented romanisation; not an official character). | [D-0757 rename 2026-09-29: Nana → Casey]; ext-review B-016

strings.zh: 嗯,没错！柑果大叔说的对！{NEWLINE}我不能因为一时的失败而放弃,{CLEAR}我要向着梦想继续前进！
strings.en: Yeah, that’s right! Uncle Apricorn is{NEWLINE}right! I can’t give up over one loss.{SCROLL}I’ll keep moving toward my dream!

strings.zh: 呀,你竟然跟过来了。{NEWLINE}我跟你说,虽然我现在比不过你,{CLEAR}可我绝不放弃和认输。{CLEAR}为了向你证明我的毅力,{CLEAR}咱们再来决斗一次吧！
strings.en: Oh, you followed me here. Listen, I{NEWLINE}can’t beat you yet.{SCROLL}But I’ll never give up or admit defeat!{SCROLL}To prove my determination to you, let’s{NEWLINE}battle again!

strings.zh: 虽然这次还是你赢,{NEWLINE}但我不会再因为输给你而灰心了。{CLEAR}我会用我的努力向你证明,{CLEAR}只要肯坚持不懈,一定能有所成就！
strings.en: You won again, but I won’t lose heart{NEWLINE}over losing to you anymore.{SCROLL}I’ll prove it to you with my hard work:{NEWLINE}if you keep at it, you’re sure to{CLEAR}achieve something!
strings.notes: | RV053: meaning: 有所成就 is ‘achieve something’, not ‘anything’; restore 向你证明/输给你

strings.zh: 我是柑果大叔,擅长制作柑果盒,{NEWLINE}那边柑果树上的果子,{CLEAR}要有大叔我做的柑果盒才能摘哦。{CLEAR}你要不要从大叔这买一个柑果盒呢,{CLEAR}对你的旅途很有帮……
strings.en: I’m Uncle Apricorn, and I make Apricorn{NEWLINE}Boxes.{SCROLL}You can only pick the fruit on that{NEWLINE}Apricorn tree if you have one of my{CLEAR}Apricorn Boxes.{SCROLL}Want to buy an Apricorn Box from me?{NEWLINE}It’ll really help you on your jour...
strings.notes: 柑果大叔 → Uncle Apricorn (#28/#31); Kurt's Apricorn Box trade #32–#38 (offers $5000 / $10000 / $20000 + Apricorn Balls).

strings.zh: 啊！你拿着的那个,{NEWLINE}是岩铁先生做的柑果盒吧！{CLEAR}真是精美,不愧是大师的作品,{CLEAR}比我做的柑果盒好多了。{SCROLL}你能不能把你的柑果盒卖给我呀,{NEWLINE}我出5000元,外加我做的柑果盒,{CLEAR}这样保证不影响你收集柑果。{SCROLL}怎么样,要交换吗？
strings.en: Ah! That thing you’re holding... It’s an{NEWLINE}Apricorn Box made by Kurt!{SCROLL}So exquisite. The work of a true{NEWLINE}master, far better than mine.{SCROLL}Would you sell me your Apricorn Box?{SCROLL}I’ll pay $5000, plus one of my own{NEWLINE}boxes.{SCROLL}That way you can still collect{NEWLINE}Apricorns.{SCROLL}So, what do you say? Want to trade?

strings.zh: 嫌我出价太低吗？{NEWLINE}那我出1万元,外加我做的柑果盒,{CLEAR}这样可以了吗？
strings.en: Is my offer too low? Then how about{NEWLINE}$10000, plus one of my Apricorn Boxes?{SCROLL}Will that do?

strings.zh: 确实,岩铁先生的柑果盒是珍品,{NEWLINE}那我出2万元加我做的柑果盒{CLEAR}以及一套柑果球套装,{CLEAR}你总该同意跟我交换了吧？
strings.en: True, Kurt’s Apricorn Box is a rare{NEWLINE}treasure.{SCROLL}Then I’ll give you $20000, one of my{NEWLINE}boxes and an Apricorn Ball set.{SCROLL}Surely you’ll trade now?

strings.zh: 你既然这么喜欢岩铁先生做的柑果盒,{NEWLINE}那就拿着当传家宝吧！
strings.en: If you love Kurt’s Apricorn Box that{NEWLINE}much, keep it as a family heirloom!

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意跟我交换,{NEWLINE}这是给你的钱和柑果盒。
strings.en: Thanks for trading with me. Here’s your{NEWLINE}money and the Apricorn Box.

strings.zh: 这是说好的柑果球套装。
strings.en: And here’s the Apricorn Ball set, as{NEWLINE}promised.

strings.zh: 岩铁先生做的柑果盒固然精美,{NEWLINE}但实际装柑果的效果,{CLEAR}与我做的普通柑果盒并没有两样。
strings.en: Kurt’s Apricorn Box sure is beautiful.{SCROLL}But for actually holding Apricorns, it’s{NEWLINE}no different from my ordinary ones.

strings.zh: 您身上只带着一只精灵,{NEWLINE}双打的话请至少带两只精灵来。
strings.en: You only have one Pokémon with you.{SCROLL}For a Double Battle, please bring at{NEWLINE}least two.

strings.zh: 我是您的铁杆粉丝,{NEWLINE}当年石英大会直播时,{CLEAR}我和朋友们在电视机前{CLEAR}争论您和小绿馆主谁强,{CLEAR}我都是坚决站在您这边的。{SCROLL}您就满足我这个铁粉的小愿望,{NEWLINE}与我来一场对战吧！
strings.en: I’m a die-hard fan of yours!{SCROLL}When the Indigo Conference was on TV,{NEWLINE}my friends and I argued over who was{CLEAR}stronger, you or Gym Leader Blue.{SCROLL}I was firmly on your side.{SCROLL}Please grant this die-hard fan’s little{NEWLINE}wish and battle me!

strings.zh: 我真是您的铁杆粉丝,{NEWLINE}当年谣传您被坂木打伤时,{CLEAR}有人就说坂木才是世上最强。{CLEAR}每次遇到这样的人{CLEAR}我就狠狠地教训他一顿,{CLEAR}坚决维护您的「最强」称号。{SCROLL}您就满足我这个铁粉的小愿望,{NEWLINE}与我来一场对战吧！
strings.en: I really am your die-hard fan!{SCROLL}Back when rumor had it that Giovanni{NEWLINE}had injured you, some people said{CLEAR}Giovanni was the strongest in the world.{SCROLL}Every time I met someone like that, I{NEWLINE}gave them a good beating to defend your{CLEAR}title as ‘the strongest’!{SCROLL}Please grant this die-hard fan’s little{NEWLINE}wish and battle me!
strings.notes: | RV053: meaning: beatings were the way of defending the title (past), not a future vow; keep 铁杆粉丝

strings.zh: 今天能在这里遇到您就是咱们的缘分,{NEWLINE}拜托您就满足我这个铁粉的小愿望,{CLEAR}与我来一场对战吧！
strings.en: Meeting you here today must be fate!{SCROLL}Please, grant this die-hard fan’s little{NEWLINE}wish and battle me!

strings.zh: 谢谢您同意与我对战,{NEWLINE}我会全力以赴的！
strings.en: Thank you for agreeing to battle me!{NEWLINE}I’ll give it everything I’ve got!

strings.zh: 我输了,输得一败涂地……{NEWLINE}呜呜呜哇啊！！！
strings.en: I lost. I got totally crushed...{NEWLINE}Waaah!!!

strings.zh: 嗯,你很有品味嘛。{NEWLINE}那么咱们来一场{CLEAR}友谊的口袋妖怪对战吧！
strings.en: Mm, you’ve got good taste. Then let’s{NEWLINE}have a friendly Pokémon battle!

strings.zh: 哇,你好厉害！{NEWLINE}根本不像是刚从若叶镇出发的初学者。{CLEAR}作为咱们对战过的纪念,{CLEAR}这个送给你吧！
strings.en: Wow, you’re amazing! You’re nothing like{NEWLINE}a beginner who just left New Bark Town.{SCROLL}Here, take this to remember our battle!

strings.zh: 为了向那位永不言弃的运动员致敬,{NEWLINE}我要好好锻炼,{CLEAR}将来用我最喜欢的{CLEAR}带条纹的黄色精灵组合,{CLEAR}拿下口袋竞技的全项目冠军！
strings.en: To honor that athlete who never gave{NEWLINE}up, I’m going to train hard.{SCROLL}Someday I’ll win every Pokéathlon event{NEWLINE}with my favorite striped yellow Pokémon!

strings.zh: 有一位漂亮的女士{NEWLINE}每周二都会来这里哦！
strings.en: A pretty lady comes here every{NEWLINE}Tuesday!

strings.zh: 发现路过的训练家,{NEWLINE}可以开始精灵对战咯！
strings.en: Spot a passing Trainer, and you can{NEWLINE}start a Pokémon battle!

strings.zh: 你浑身上下散发着强者的气息,{NEWLINE}我还是离你远点吧。
strings.en: You’ve got a strong Trainer’s aura all{NEWLINE}over you. I’d better keep my distance.

strings.zh: 我只和新人训练家对战,{NEWLINE}像你这种一看就很厉害的高手,{CLEAR}还是找别人切磋去吧。
strings.en: I only battle new Trainers. Anyone can{NEWLINE}see you’re a real pro, so go spar with{CLEAR}someone else.
strings.notes: | RV053: omission: 一看就很厉害
